words.example: Your March salary slip is ready in the payroll portal.
words.exampleZh: 你三月的工资单已经可以在薪酬门户里查看。

words.example: Pay day falls on the fifteenth unless that day is a holiday.
words.exampleZh: 发薪日是十五号，除非当天是假日。

words.example: This month's allowance includes meals and local bus fares.
words.exampleZh: 这个月的津贴包括餐补和市内公交费。

words.example: The annual bonus is paid together with the December salary.
words.exampleZh: 年度奖金和十二月的工资一起发放。

words.example: Please file your overtime claim before noon on Thursday.
words.exampleZh: 请在周四中午之前提交加班申报。

words.example: AppLocker stopped the user from running a portable browser out of Downloads.
words.exampleZh: 应用锁阻止用户从下载目录运行便携版浏览器。

words.example: Software Restriction on the kiosk blocks executables that are not under Program Files.
words.exampleZh: 查询机上的软件限制策略会拦截不在 Program Files 里的可执行文件。

words.example: Device Guard on the kiosk image refuses any kernel driver we have not signed.
words.exampleZh: 查询机镜像上的设备防护会拒绝我们没有签名的内核驱动。

words.example: Credential Guard kept the stolen process from reading hashes out of memory.
words.exampleZh: 凭据防护让那个被盗用的进程读不到内存里的哈希。

words.example: LSA protection is enabled, so untrusted tools cannot read credentials from that process.
words.exampleZh: 认证进程保护已经打开，不受信任的工具读不到那个进程里的凭据。
